card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The leading digit of a section number inside a bracketed cross-reference such as [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1)]. It also fires on the middle of the word pathophysiology in a pronunciation guide.

modes.label: Section number in cross-reference
modes.description: The first digit (5 or 8) of a section number in parentheses after a label section name, just before the decimal point.

modes.label: Inside a pronunciation guide
modes.description: A syllable inside a dotted phonetic spelling of a medical term.

card.writes: It suppresses odd unrelated tokens and promotes punctuation that closes a sentence before a bracket, which suggests the number is followed by a decimal point and a closing reference.
card.plain: It marks the first digit of a section number in a label's see-also reference, such as Warnings and Precautions (5.1).
